auto_create_opposite: Auto-create opposite voucher on Delivery Challan / Receipt Note generation
auto_create_opposite_description: A Delivery Challan creates a matching Receipt Note at the destination, and a Receipt Note creates a Delivery Challan at the source.
inventory_via_business_document_descript: Update inventory through Delivery Challans and Receipt Notes.
auto_generate_dc: Generate Delivery Challan automatically while generating Invoice
auto_generate_dc_description: Every sales invoice creates a linked Delivery Challan using the invoice warehouse and line items.
auto_generate_rc: Generate Receipt Note automatically while generating Bill
auto_generate_rc_description: Every purchase bill creates a linked Receipt Note against the receiving warehouse.
item_wise_report_description: Choose whether item-wise reports calculate balances from accounting stock or from physical stock.
group_wise_report_description: Choose whether group-wise reports calculate balances from accounting stock or from physical stock.
variant_wise_report_description: Choose whether variant-wise reports calculate balances from accounting stock or from physical stock.
